exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and fill in the appropriate object or subject pronouns, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va mos ega yoki obyekt olmoshini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
Har bir bandda IKKI bo'shliq:

  Look at ____ .     → 'at' predlogidan keyin → OBYEKT olmoshi
  ____ is a ... .    → fe'ldan oldin        → EGA olmoshi

NAMUNA (tuya rasmi):
  Look at IT.  IT is a camel.
  ('it' ikkala vazifada ham bir xil)

RASMLAR:
  1) tuya            → narsa/hayvon
  2) qo'shiq aytayotgan ayol → ayol
  3) raqsga tushayotgan juftlik → ko'plik
  4) o't o'chiruvchi   → erkak
  5) samolyot         → narsa

items.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Hayvon, jinsi noma'lum → it.
Kitobdagi namuna. Gap boshida — katta harf.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in he, she, they, them, her, it, I or his.
exercises.instructionUz: he, she, they, them, her, it, I yoki his — birini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXATDA UCH XIL OLMOSH ARALASH:

  EGA olmoshlari:    he, she, they, it, I
  OBYEKT olmoshi:    them
  EGALIK sifatlari:   her, his

HAR BIR BO'SHLIQ UCHUN:
  1) fe'ldan oldinmi? → EGA (he, she, they, it, I)
  2) fe'l/predlogdan keyinmi? → OBYEKT (them)
  3) keyin OT bormi? → EGALIK SIFATI (her, his)

DIQQAT: 'her' ikki vazifada ham bo'ladi —
bu betda esa EGALIK sifati sifatida ('her name', 'her hair').

lines.whyUz: 'Do you ...?' savoliga 'I do' deb javob beriladi. 'I' doim KATTA harf.
Keyin OT bor → EGALIK sifati. Singil — ayol → Her.
Fe'l ('is') dan oldin → EGA shakli. Ayol → she.
Piter — erkak, fe'ldan oldin → he.
Fe'ldan oldin → EGA. Gap boshida katta harf. 'hates' — 3-shaxs -s.
To'p — narsa → it.
'haven't got' — I/you/we/they bilan. Gapiruvchi o'zi haqida → I.
Keyin ot bor → egalik sifati. 'Mrs' — turmush qurgan ayol → Her.
'She's' = She is. Fe'ldan oldin → ega shakli.
'it's' = it is. Velosiped — narsa → it.
Ot yo'q → EGALIK OLMOSHI. Harold erkak → his.
'Do you ...?' → 'I ...'. Katta harf.
Fe'l ('love') dan keyin → OBYEKT shakli. 'films' ko'plik → them.
Fe'ldan oldin → ega. Katta harf.
'they're' = they are. 'films' ko'plik → they.
Ona — ayol, fe'ldan oldin → she.
'She's got' = She has got. Katta harf.

lines.textEn: ... and ____ hair is long and red.
lines.whyUz: Keyin ot bor → EGALIK sifati. Ayol → her.

exercises.instructionEn: Look at the pictures and fill in the possessive pronouns/adjectives or the people's names, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Rasmlarga qarang va egalik olmoshi/sifati yoki odamlarning ismini qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
RASMLAR JADVALI — kim nimaga egalik qiladi:

  Mark           — trumpet (karnay)
  Claire         — computer (kompyuter)
  Jason          — motorbike (mototsikl)
  Joanne         — TV (televizor)
  Jessica        — telephone (telefon)
  Mike           — balloons (sharlar)
  Bill & Laura   — car (mashina)
  Andrew & Lucy  — house (uy)
  Paul           — books (kitoblar)
  Linda          — flowers (gullar)
  John           — umbrella (soyabon)
  Denise         — pen (ruchka)

NAMUNA:
  A: Is that Mark's trumpet?
  B: Yes, it's HIS. It's HIS trumpet.

QOLIP — javob TO'G'RI bo'lsa:
  Yes, it's + EGALIK OLMOSHI. It's + EGALIK SIFATI + ot.

QOLIP — javob NOTO'G'RI bo'lsa:
  No, it isn't + EGALIK OLMOSHI. It's + HAQIQIY EGASI + 's.

DIQQAT: birinchi bo'shliqda ot YO'Q → olmosh (his, hers, theirs).
Ikkinchisida ot BOR → sifat (his, her, their) yoki ism + 's.

lines.whyUz: Kitobdagi namuna. Mark — erkak. Birinchisi olmosh (otsiz), ikkinchisi sifat (ot bilan). 'his' ikkalasida ham bir xil.
Jessikaniki EMAS → 'hers' (ayol, otsiz). Rasmda kompyuter Claire'niki → Claire's.
Jeyson — erkak. Otsiz → his (olmosh), ot bilan → his (sifat).

lines.textEn: Is that Bill and Laura's TV?

lines.hintUz: Ikki kishi haqida; rasmda televizor boshqa odamniki
lines.whyUz: Ikki kishi → 'theirs' (ko'plik, otsiz). Rasmda televizor Joanne'niki → Joanne's.

lines.hintUz: Jon — erkak; rasmda telefon boshqa odamniki
lines.whyUz: Jonniki EMAS → 'his'. Rasmda telefon Jessikaniki → Jessica's.
Mayk — erkak. Ko'plik ot bo'lsa ham egalik olmoshi o'zgarmaydi: 'his'.

lines.hintUz: Deniz — ayol; rasmda mashina ikki kishiga tegishli
lines.whyUz: Denizniki EMAS → 'hers'. Rasmda mashina Bill va Loraniki → 's oxirgi ismga.

lines.textEn: Is that Andrew and Lucy's house?

lines.hintUz: Ikki kishi; birinchisi otsiz, ikkinchisi ot bilan
lines.whyUz: Rasmda uy ularniki. Otsiz → theirs (olmosh), ot bilan → their (sifat). Bu ikkisi FARQ qiladi!

lines.hintUz: Savol 'mening' deb so'ragan — javobda 'sening'; rasmda kitoblar boshqa odamniki
lines.whyUz: Savolda 'my' → javobda 'yours' (seniki emas). Rasmda kitoblar Polniki → Paul's.

exercises.instructionEn: Compare the possessive adjective and the possessive pronoun.
exercises.instructionUz: Egalik sifati va egalik olmoshini solishtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
3-mashqda ba'zi shakllar BIR XIL, ba'zilari FARQLI.
Farqni yaxshi bilish uchun jadvalni to'ldiring.

  BIR XIL:  his / his
  FARQLI:   her / hers,  their / theirs,  our / ours,
            my / mine,   your / yours

items.textEn: It's ____ house. (Andrew va Lucy — ot bilan)

items.whyUz: Ot yo'q → egalik olmoshi 'theirs'. Bu FARQ qiladi!
Ot yo'q → egalik olmoshi 'hers'. FARQ qiladi!

exercises.instructionEn: Learn the objects in the picture grid.

groups.explanationUz: Ba'zi olmoshlar ikki vazifada bir xil ko'rinadi — chalkashmaslik uchun GAP TUZILISHIGA qarang.
Bu juftliklarda sifat va olmosh SHAKLI boshqa — eng ko'p xato shu yerda.
Dialogda deyarli har doim qisqa shakl ishlatiladi.

patterns.formula: Look at + OBYEKT olmoshi. + EGA olmoshi + is/are + ...
patterns.exampleEn: Look at it. It is a camel. Look at her. She is a singer.
patterns.exampleUz: Unga qara. U tuya. Unga qara. U qo'shiqchi.
patterns.explanationUz:
Birinchi gapda obyekt shakli (predlogdan keyin),
ikkinchisida ega shakli (fe'ldan oldin).

patterns.exampleEn: Her name is Sara. Her hair is long and red.
patterns.exampleUz: Uning ismi Sara. Uning sochi uzun va qizil.

patterns.formula: Is that ISM's + ot? — Yes, it's + EGALIK OLMOSHI. It's + EGALIK SIFATI + ot.
patterns.exampleEn: Is that Mark's trumpet? — Yes, it's his. It's his trumpet.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu Markning karnayimi? — Ha, uniki. Bu uning karnayi.
patterns.explanationUz: Birinchi javob otsiz (olmosh), ikkinchisi ot bilan (sifat).

patterns.formula: No, it isn't + EGALIK OLMOSHI. It's + ISM's.
patterns.exampleEn: No, it isn't hers. It's Claire's.
patterns.explanationUz:
Rad etish va haqiqiy egasini aytish.
Ikkalasida ham ot takrorlanmaydi.

patterns.formula: I think it's + ISM's. Yes, it's + EGALIK OLMOSHI.
patterns.exampleEn: I think it's Harold's. Yes, it's his.
Is this your football? — No, it isn't. I haven't got one.
patterns.exampleUz: Bu sening to'pingmi? — Yo'q. Menda yo'q.
